lines.t: light breaks over the hills,
shadows fade where the lost stand still.
a voice calls from beyond the dust,
rise, walk, kingdom rising must.
i’ve seen the towers, i’ve seen the gold,
i’ve felt the weight of lies untold.
the world shouts loud, its fire burns high,
but truth whispers soft — you can’t deny.
hands once empty now hold the flame,
he calls my name, i will not be the same.
the narrow road, the path of light,
through trials, through storms, into the fight.
cast off the pride, shed every chain,
walk through the fire, bear no shame.
not of men, not of their praise,
his kingdom rises in mysterious ways.
kingdom rising, the dawn ignites,
through the darkness, through the nights.
stand and tremble, then stand tall,
hearts awakened to the call.
through thunder, lightning, storm, and flame,
we follow him, we speak his name.
he lifted the broken, healed the weak,
the humble listen, the proud still seek.
words of life, not just tradition,
a covenant forged with full submission.
the earth may shake, the sky may roar,
but his presence strikes at every core.
we rise together, a chosen few,
his way alive, ever true.
walk the path, no delay,
light your soul, turn the gray away.
commandments alive, not just a scroll,
obedience flowing, it saves the soul.
narrow gates, wide roads deceive,
heaven waits for those who believe.
stand fast, move quick, no time to stall,
kingdom rising — answer the call.
kingdom rising, the dawn ignites,
through the darkness, through the nights.
stand and tremble, then stand tall,
hearts awakened to the call.
through thunder, lightning, storm, and flame,
we follow him, we speak his name.
[Outro – soft piano, harp, heartbeat rhythm fades]
“rise… walk the way.”
“behold… the kingdom comes.”
— YahuShua-YAHUWAH
